d:
Long, straight jet black hair with blunt-cut hime-style bangs. Sharp, narrow almond-shaped deep crimson eyes. Appears to be a mature late-teen with a calm, stoic expression. Slender build with a graceful posture. Wears a traditional miko outfit consisting of a white kimono top with wide sleeves and red hakama trousers. Signature details include a large red bow tied at the back of the neck and a small white paper charm attached to the hair.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain skin
